ANSWER: NO
HALLUCINATIONS: None

All key financial terms in the memo are supported by the source document:

- Date of Agreement (March 31, 2021) - confirmed
- Borrower name (MGE Niagara Entertainment Inc.) - confirmed
- Administrative Agent (Bank of Montreal) - confirmed
- Guarantor (Complex Services Inc.) - confirmed
- Original credit agreement date (June 10, 2019) - confirmed
- Extended Waiver Period (through September 30, 2021) - confirmed
- Minimum liquidity requirement ($12.5 million, reduced from $15 million) - confirmed
- Extension fee (5 basis points on each consenting lender's commitment) - confirmed
- Level 5 pricing rates (BA/LC/LIBOR: 5.00%, Prime/USBR: 3.50%, Undrawn Fee: 1.25%) - confirmed in Schedule B
- Weekly reporting requirements (due each Tuesday) - confirmed
- Financial covenant sections (9.4.1 and 9.4.2) - confirmed
- OLG support terms and 5 business day trigger - confirmed

The memo accurately represents all financial terms found in the source document without adding unsupported details.

ANSWER: YES
MISSING_TERMS: 
1. Administrative Agent: Bank of Montreal
2. Guarantor: Complex Services Inc.
3. Original Credit Agreement date: June 10, 2019 (amended July 17, 2019)
4. Financial covenant sections being waived: Sections 9.4.1 and 9.4.2 of the Credit Agreement
5. Closure Default definition: Event of Default under Section 11.1.11 for closures exceeding 60 consecutive days
6. OLG relief letter dates: April 19, 2020, June 11, 2020, and June 12, 2020
7. Previous waiver timeline and progression (May 2020 through November 2020 waivers)
8. Compliance Certificate delivery requirements under Section 9.1.1.3(a)
9. Annual Business Plan delivery requirements under Section 9.1.1.4
10. Restrictions on amending Leases, MGE Management Agreement, CNHI Consulting Agreement, and Convertible Debentures
11. Complete pricing grid showing all 5 levels with corresponding leverage ratios and rates
12. Governing law: Province of Ontario and federal laws of Canada
